en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1242 - Muhammad ibn Muslim narrated from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as)
regarding the words of Prophet Ya'qub (Jacob) to his sons:
"I will seek forgiveness for you from my Lord (azj)" (Surah Yusuf 12:98).”
Imam (as) said: "He delayed it until the time of Sahar (pre-dawn) on the night of Jumu’ah."
